Aisha (CS Ops): Noticing a spike in duplicate welcome sequences this morning. Looks like playbook automation fired twice for accounts with multiple active trial contacts.
Ravi (CS Tools): Which condition caused the double fire? dedupe by contact id or by email?
Aisha (CS Ops): It's triggering when owner is null and contact_count >1. The webhook treats each contact as a separate event so the playbook runs per contact.
Tom (AE): Got two welcome emails to the same company, customers pinged me. Small but annoying.
Nina (Data Eng): Can you paste a minimal event example (no PII)?
Aisha (CS Ops): Example event: {account: 4121, contacts: [c_201, c_202], owner: null, event_type: 'trial_started'}
Ravi (CS Tools): Ok. Current flow: webhook -> playbook decision -> run. Dedupe key is email || contact_id || owner_null_fallback. The fallback is too broad.
Ravi (CS Tools): Quick mitigation: change fallback to require owner_null AND last_touch > 21d. Also add a suppression toggle API so AEs can suppress for a week.
Aisha (CS Ops): Suppression API good. Need an audit trail (who suppressed, why, expiry).
Tom (AE): I want to suppress a couple accounts while I do outreach. How will I do that?
Ravi (CS Tools): We'll add POST /api/v1/playbook/suppress body: {account_id, user_id, days, reason}. playbook-bot will skip suppressed accounts.
Nina (Data Eng): On the scoring side, the quick automation nudged some accounts into "engagement_low" because our window is 3 days. I'd recommend moving engagement_decay to 14 days and rerunning the recent 60-day backtest.
Aisha (CS Ops): That would reduce noise. Can you run the backtest and share flip counts?
Nina (Data Eng): Yes. I can run a job and drop results here by EOD.
Ravi (CS Tools): Rollout plan: patch dedupe rule + suppression endpoint -> staging deploy -> enable 10% canary for 24h -> monitor -> expand.
Aisha (CS Ops): Who owns the patch?
Ravi (CS Tools): I'll own the code change and PR. Nina owns the backtest. Aisha will triage CS inbox and tag affected AEs.
Tom (AE): Please add my accounts to the canary: 4121, 4992.
Ravi (CS Tools): Added. playbook-bot: will annotate canary accounts with :canary: in logs.
playbook-bot: Canary toggles updated in staging. Use `/playbook status canary` to view.
Nina (Data Eng): Backtest summary: switching to 14d engagement window reduces false "renewal_risk" flips by ~6.5% across trial cohort. Full CSV attached in follow-up.
Aisha (CS Ops): That's promising. Let's proceed with the hotfix and 10% canary after PR lands. I'll inform support and update the customer-facing FAQ about duplicate messages.
Ravi (CS Tools): Opening PR #512 with changes and suppression schema: playbook_suppression_log(account_id, user, reason, expires_at, created_at). CI running.
playbook-bot: PR #512 opened by Ravi. CI checks queued.
